subject: rt-algn
title: RT.ALGN.------WO.EXP.PRIN.
description: Chart 3 of 3 on book p. 47 (WM-23). RT-ALGN (reality alignment) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; WO-EXP-PRIN is the partner. From the subject: EXP-DY (expansion dynamics) and VT-PLT (vibrational platform). From EXP-DY: LANG-DY (language dynamics), IST-F-ACT and TR (transformation). From LANG-DY: LK-IMP (linkage implications) and LG-DY (logical dynamics). From IST-F-ACT: V-SY (value system). From V-SY: INT (intention), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From TR: PROG-CONT (progressional continuance). From VT-PLT: INFO-DY. From INFO-DY: C-CONT (composite continuance).
